tools.name: resolve_entities
tools.description: Looks up teams, competitions, countries, cities and stadiums by English name and returns their Football Finder ids, which the other tools take. Use it first whenever the user names a team, competition or place. Names with no match are listed as unresolved, with the closest name held when there is on

tools.name: search_fixtures
tools.description: Lists matches in a date window, filtered by Football Finder ids for teams, competitions or stadiums, by a point and radius, by a city slug or by a country code. Use it for "what is on" questions. Returns up to 25 matches in kickoff order, or biggest competitions first; "truncated": true means more e

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: Returns one match: kickoff in local time, venue, competition, recent form, head-to-head, league positions, players to watch, the cheapest ticket price held, and a written preview when one exists. Use it for questions about a specific match. The match url opens its footballfinder.app page, which list

tools.name: get_match_description
tools.description: Returns Football Finder's written description of a match. Use it when the user wants background on a match. status "none" means no description has been written for that match.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Returns a team's country, founding year and coach and, on request, players to watch, last five results and full squad. Use it for questions about a team.

tools.name: get_stadium
tools.description: Returns a ground's city, capacity, surface and resident clubs, the nearest train, metro and bus stops with walking times, and atmosphere notes by stand when held. It also returns how many places to eat, drink and stay near the ground Football Finder lists, with the page that shows them. Use it for q

tools.name: find_trip_windows
tools.description: Finds runs of days for seeing several matches, scored by the matches a visitor could attend. Use it for trip planning, such as a few days in a city or when to travel to see a team. Accepts a city slug, team or competition ids, a date range and a trip length; with no filters it returns the top trips

tools.name: get_city_guide
tools.description: Returns Football Finder's short highlights for visitors to a city, and how many places to eat, drink and see it lists, with the page that shows them. Use it for what to do around a match. No highlights and no places mean the city is not covered yet.

tools.name: get_tickets
tools.description: Returns the ticket options held for a match, cheapest first, with prices in the venue's currency. Use it for ticket questions. "partnerListings": 0 means no ticket marketplace lists the match yet. The match url opens its page, which lists every seller.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_match, get_tickets · Public sink: resolve_entities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_match, get_tickets · Public sink: resolve_entities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
